description: Save a PAPER/TESTNET exchange's API keys to your account and link them to a webhook, in one step -- for an agent that has a practice account's keys and no browser. Only OANDAPRACTICE, CRYPTODEMO, BYBITTESTNET, BYBITSPOTTESTNET, TRADOVATESIM are accepted (they never move real money); real-money exchanges are refused whatever your token's scope, and their keys must be added on autoview.com in a browser (see connect). Credential field names per exchange -- OANDAPRACTICE: id (Account ID), private (Access Token); CRYPTODEMO: public (API Key), private (Secret Key); BYBITTESTNET: public (API Key), private (Private Key); BYBITSPOTTESTNET: public (API Key), private (Private Key); TRADOVATESIM: public (Username), private (Password), cid (CID), sec (Secret). The keys are encrypted and stored exactly as the website's setup form stores them, and are never echoed back. hook_id, if given, must be one of your own hooks with no exchange linked yet (an order fires on every exchange a hook links); omit it to use an empty hook of yours or get a new one. Then call entry with the returned hook_id (dry-run by default) to check the keys work. Requires your Autoview account token; any token can link a paper exchange.

credentials.description: the practice account's credential fields, keyed by field name (see this tool's description for each exchange's names), e.g. {"public": "<api key>", "private": "<secret>"} for CRYPTODEMO

exchange.description: the paper/testnet exchange these keys belong to

hook_id.description: link this specific hook of yours (it must have no exchange linked yet); omit to use an empty hook or create a new one

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: link
